svg.title: Shadewright reviewer hints
svg.desc: A reviewer with write access comments on the pull request at the code host. The executor, through its GitProvider adapter and a narrow FeedbackSource interface, reads the comment, checks the author's permission in the code host, redacts and bounds the text and pins it into the status of the RemediationRequest, which only the executor writes. The analyzer reads the pinned hint, analyzes again with the hint as a fenced reviewer-input section, and proposes a new RemediationRequest that names the one it replaces. The executor takes the existing pull request and branch over to the new request, adds one commit to the same branch, creates the required check run shadewright/review, which only an approval of the latest head from someone who wrote no hint can satisfy, and replies in the same pull request. Integrations other than the code host (on-call tools, chat, inbound alerts) belong to a future shadewright-coordinator with one credential per integration; how its hints reach the status is decided in its own ADR. A hint never authorizes anything: the policy still decides. Built, and off by default until the executor flag --reviewer-hints (chart value executor.reviewerHints.enabled) turns it on: the adapter's reads of comments and permission, the executor's hint intake (permission, redaction, bounds, pin), the handoff of the pull request with its one commit, the check run shadewright/review, and the replies in the pull request (a fixed template, redacted, posted only when nothing would be redacted, once per comment); the analyzer's part (it reads a pinned hint, analyzes with it fenced and proposes the replacement) is built too. Planned: the coordinator and other systems, and the ruleset that makes the check a required merge gate in each repository. The merge gate (the required check shadewright/review, which no hint author can satisfy) is off by default and its ruleset is planned. A hint is redacted and bounded before it is pinned by ID, digest and time, and the replies in the pull request use a fixed template. svg.text: Off by default (--reviewer-hints). Dashed: planned. A hint never authorizes: the policy decides.
